204.description: Bel’mare, at Praia de Faro, welcomes calm, well-behaved dogs of any size indoors and outside, with water available for pets. Facing the Atlantic, it combines a restaurant, bar and rooftop. Its menu includes fish, seafood, meat, poke bowls and sharing dishes. The venue also operates a beach concession with food and drink service, making it a convenient stop with your dog by the sea in Faro.

205.description: Sal’mare, at Praia de Faro, welcomes calm, well-behaved dogs of any size both indoors and on its terrace. Water is available for pets. During the day it has a relaxed beach-club atmosphere, while in the evening it becomes a steakhouse focused on premium cuts of meat. With a terrace beside the sand, it is easy to combine a meal with a walk along Faro Beach with your dog.

206.description: Spot Local in Moncarapacho is both a café and accommodation welcoming well-behaved pets, subject to advance arrangement. Animals are permitted in the café and guest rooms but must stay on a lead in the café and while exploring the grounds. A fee of €20 per pet per night applies. It is a useful pet-friendly option for a coffee or an overnight stay in the eastern Algarve.

211.description: Toska Hamburgueria, on Rua João Augusto Saias in Olhão, welcomes dogs on its terrace, where water is available. Known for its handmade burgers, it also offers wraps, bruschetta, salads, bowls and vegetarian and vegan choices. It is an informal place for a relaxed meal with your dog in Olhão.

212.description: Tavira Plaza is a shopping centre in Tavira where dogs are welcome indoors when accompanied and kept on a non-retractable lead no longer than one metre. The centre has shops, food outlets and services, making it possible to run errands with your dog. Dogs classified as potentially dangerous must also comply with the legal muzzle requirements. It is particularly useful on hot or rainy days.

215.description: Hola Torito, on Avenida 5 de Outubro in Olhão, is a Mexican restaurant welcoming dogs on its terrace. Water is available for pets, which must remain on a lead. The menu includes tacos, nachos, guacamole, burritos and other Mexican favourites, along with vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options. A lively choice for lunch or dinner with your dog in central Olhão.

216.description: NATSU Tavira, on Travessa José Pires Padinha in Tavira, welcomes dogs on its outdoor terrace as long as they remain on a lead. The Japanese-inspired menu goes beyond sushi, with ramen, yakisoba, gyoza, bao buns, donburi, vegetarian options and Asian-style desserts. Its central location makes it an easy place to combine a walk through Tavira with a meal outside alongside your dog.

217.description: Primitivo Tavira, on Praça Dr. António Padinha in central Tavira, welcomes dogs both indoors and on the terrace. Dogs must remain on a lead, and water is available. Fire is central to the restaurant’s cooking, with grilled meat, fish, seafood and vegetarian dishes on a seasonal menu. It is a distinctive place for lunch or dinner with your dog in Tavira.

219.description: Quiosque da Alfarrobeira, in Parque Urbano da Alfarrobeira in Albufeira, welcomes dogs on its outdoor terrace, with water available for pets. Surrounded by walking paths, lawns and recreational areas, the kiosk-bar is a handy place for a drink or a break during a walk with your dog. There is also a fenced dog park nearby.

220.description: Parque Canino da Alfarrobeira, within Parque Urbano da Alfarrobeira in central Albufeira, is a fenced dog area where dogs can run and play off-lead. The enclosure has exercise obstacles, open space, shade and benches for owners. Entry is free. The wider urban park also offers walking paths, a fitness area, a playground, picnic facilities and a bar. It is a practical place for off-lead exercise and socialisation in Albufeira.

221.description: Frente ao Mar, on Rua Mascarenhas Gregório in Armação de Pêra, welcomes dogs on its outdoor terrace. The café and bar serves breakfast, brunch, lunch and drinks, with burgers, salads, sandwiches, crêpes and ice cream among the options. Its spacious, shady terrace makes it a convenient stop with your dog close to the seafront.

224.description: Sambé Beach, at Praia de Santo António in Vila Real de Santo António, allows dogs on its outdoor terrace. The beach restaurant and bar is a place to enjoy a meal, a drink or a break close to the sand with your dog beside you. It offers an easy option for dog owners exploring this part of the eastern Algarve.

225.description: Originato, on Rua José Pires Padinha in Tavira, welcomes dogs indoors provided they remain on a lead. Close to the river and the ferry departure point for Tavira Island, the café serves breakfast, brunch and light meals, including bagels, pancakes, bowls, eggs, smoothies and coffee. It is a convenient stop with your dog before or after exploring Tavira’s historic centre and riverside.

226.description: Daiya Sushi Tavira, at Fábrica Balsense in Tavira, welcomes dogs both indoors and outside. Alongside sushi, the restaurant offers contemporary Asian dishes, hot meals, creative combinations, cocktails and sharing plates. Its terrace is inviting on warm days, while indoor seating makes it an option throughout the year. A useful dog-friendly choice for lunch or dinner in Tavira.

228.description: Antisocial, in Guia near Albufeira, welcomes dogs indoors. Describing itself as a concept rather than simply a brunch spot or coffee shop, it serves focaccia sandwiches, house-made pastries and speciality coffee in a laid-back setting. It is an appealing choice for a meal or coffee with your dog in Guia, without needing to sit outside.

229.description: Café Formosa, on Rua José Pires Padinha in Tavira, welcomes dogs indoors. Specialising in speciality coffee, it also serves breakfast and light lunches, including focaccia, pastries, fresh juices and matcha, with vegan options available. It is a relaxed place for coffee or a bite to eat with your dog near Tavira’s historic centre.

241.description: Old Times Bistro, Bar & Coffee in Manta Rota, in the municipality of Vila Real de Santo António, welcomes dogs both indoors and on the terrace. Offering café, bar and restaurant service, it is a convenient place for breakfast, a meal or a drink with your dog. You can choose between indoor and outdoor seating when visiting Manta Rota.

249.description: Abigail’s Café in Lagos is a café and bakery welcoming well-behaved, sociable dogs indoors. It serves breakfast, brunch, lunch and speciality coffee, focusing on homemade food and locally sourced ingredients whenever possible. The menu includes juices, smoothies, and vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free choices. It is a good option for a light, relaxed meal with your dog in central Lagos.

255.description: AREL – Padaria & Cozinha in Aljezur welcomes dogs indoors. Located on Rua 25 de Abril, it combines an artisan bakery with a kitchen, serving sourdough bread, pastries and food throughout the day. It is a handy stop for breakfast, lunch or coffee with your dog in the centre of the village, especially for visitors exploring Aljezur and the Vicentine Coast.

256.description: Salema Tours, based at Salema Beach in the municipality of Vila do Bispo, allows dogs on boat trips when sea conditions permit. The company offers dolphin-watching trips, visits to coastal caves and Benagil Cave, fishing excursions and kayak hire. If taking a dog aboard is not advisable, the animal may be left ashore in the care of the animal-loving team while its owners enjoy the trip. This offers a distinctive way to explore the Algarve coast without leaving your dog out of the experience.

269.description: Belém – Brunch Bar in Tavira welcomes small and medium-sized dogs both indoors and on the terrace. The all-day concept combines brunch, coffee and cocktails, with options for breakfast, lunch or a relaxed break. Being able to choose between indoor and outdoor seating makes it a practical place to eat with your dog in Tavira, Algarve.

271.description: Earth Shop & Café in Carvoeiro, in the municipality of Lagoa, welcomes dogs indoors and on the terrace, with a maximum of three animals. If a dog barks indoors, staff may ask that it stay outside. Overlooking the sea, the café and shop serves breakfast and brunch throughout the day, including bowls, wraps, salads, smoothies and coffee. It is a convenient dog-friendly spot for breakfast or lunch in central Carvoeiro.

284.description: Parque Canino de Quarteira, in the municipality of Loulé, is a fenced dog park where dogs can run freely in a safe enclosure. Opened in May 2026 and located beside the Continente supermarket, it has equipment, areas for spending time with dogs and signs explaining the rules. It is a practical off-leash option in Quarteira where dogs can run, play and socialise in a purpose-built space, with easy access during a walk around town.

298.description: Zénite Rooftop Bar at Kimpton Atlântico Algarve in Albufeira welcomes dogs indoors and on the terrace, provided they stay on a lead. Water is available for pets. With panoramic Atlantic views, the rooftop offers signature cocktails, music and Peruvian- and Nikkei-inspired food, making it especially appealing in the late afternoon and at sunset. It is a relaxed place for a drink or light bite with your dog near the sea in Albufeira.

299.description: NAU São Rafael Suites in Albufeira is a five-star dog-friendly hotel accepting pets weighing up to 15 kg, with a maximum of one pet per room. Dogs may stay in family rooms and access permitted hotel areas but must be kept on a lead. There is an extra charge of €25 per night and a €100 deposit is required at check-in. The hotel provides a bed, bowl, water and a small surprise for your pet. With spacious outdoor areas and a location near São Rafael Beach, it is a comfortable option for an Algarve holiday with your dog.

300.description: Tascaria São Rafael in Albufeira is a dog-friendly restaurant at NAU São Rafael Suites, where dogs are welcome indoors. They must remain on a lead, and water is available for them. The restaurant is also open to guests who are not staying at the hotel and serves traditional Portuguese cuisine featuring local produce and regional flavours. It is a pleasant option for dinner with your dog in Albufeira, in a smart setting near São Rafael and Sesmarias beaches.

301.description: Kimpton Atlântico Algarve in Albufeira is a dog-friendly hotel welcoming dogs of any size or breed, with no limit on the number of pets and no additional fee or deposit. Pets may stay in rooms and access communal areas, terraces and outdoor spaces; the Wellness Hub Atlântico is the only restricted area. On request, the hotel provides a pet bed, food and water bowls, treats, toys and waste bags. It is a particularly flexible choice for staying with dogs in the Algarve without size restrictions or extra pet charges.

303.description: Altentica Pizzaria in Ferreiras, Albufeira, welcomes dogs on its terrace, where water is available for pets. Dogs must remain on a lead. The restaurant specialises in freshly made pizza and pasta, with vegetarian and gluten-free options too. Its informal, family-friendly outdoor seating makes it a convenient choice for dinner with your dog in the Ferreiras area.

305.description: The Westin Salgados Beach Resort in Albufeira welcomes dogs and cats weighing up to 10 kg, with a maximum of one pet per room. There is an additional charge of €17 per night. Pets may stay in the room, have water available and must be kept on a lead in permitted areas. Located between Salgados Beach and the lagoon in the Salgados Nature Reserve, the resort offers extensive outdoor spaces, pools, a spa and several restaurants for an Algarve holiday with your pet.

307.description: Nosolo Itália in Portimão, on Praça Manuel Teixeira Gomes, allows dogs on the terrace, so you can enjoy a meal together in the city centre. This is where the Nosolo Italia concept began, and the extensive Italian-inspired menu includes pizza, pasta, salads, meat, fish, crêpes, waffles and its well-known handmade ice cream. It's a practical place for lunch, dinner or an ice cream with your dog near Portimão's waterfront.

356.description: Café Kapheina in São Bartolomeu de Messines, in the municipality of Silves, welcomes dogs on the terrace and provides water for them. Located in the centre of the village, it is a handy place to stop for coffee, breakfast or a light meal with your dog at an outdoor table. The terrace and available water make visits more comfortable, whether you're walking around Messines or stopping on a journey through inland Algarve.

389.description: Pão do Rogil, in Rogil in the municipality of Aljezur, welcomes dogs on its terraces. This artisan bakery on the Vicentine Coast makes bread, cakes and biscuits inspired by regional flavours, including Aljezur sweet potatoes, carob and almonds. The menu also includes toasties, sandwiches, pies, focaccia, savoury croissants and ice cream. Its several outdoor terraces make it a convenient place to stop with your dog while exploring the Vicentine Coast.

390.description: MÁDÁ in Sítio de Santa Susana, Aljezur, is a dog-friendly restaurant that welcomes dogs indoors and on the terrace, with water available for them. The steakhouse and bar focuses on cuts of meat and relaxed meals made for sharing. The restaurant confirms that pets are welcome as long as its rules and other guests' comfort are respected. Its position beside the EN120 makes it a convenient stop when travelling through Aljezur with your dog.

396.description: Mahalo Restaurant & Bar in Santa Bárbara de Nexe, in the municipality of Faro, welcomes dogs both indoors and on the terrace. The relaxed restaurant combines Portuguese and Mediterranean food, with meat, fish, small plates, vegan options and cocktails. It has outdoor tables and a rooftop bar, and the restaurant explicitly allows pets. If you're looking for somewhere to eat with your dog in inland Algarve, you can choose indoor or outdoor seating.

397.description: Restaurante O Ténis in Portimão welcomes dogs on its terrace, which sits in a fenced outdoor area. Located beside the Municipal Tennis Complex, the restaurant serves traditional Algarve cuisine, including fresh fish, tapas-style dishes and charcoal-grilled specialities such as grilled sardines and cuttlefish. Its spacious terrace is a practical option for enjoying a meal outdoors with your dog in Portimão.

400.description: Pastelaria Colibri II in Galé, Albufeira, welcomes dogs on its terrace, which has plenty of shade and water available for pets. Known for pastries, coffee, breakfast and light meals, it has several outdoor tables where you can take a comfortable break with your dog. Located near Galé Shopping Centre, close to the beaches and main roads in this part of Albufeira, it is a practical stop for breakfast, brunch or coffee during a walk around Galé.

422.description: Pena D’Água Boutique Hotel & Villas in Covilhã welcomes pets of any size, with up to three per room subject to confirmation. Pets may stay in the room and access the bar, reception and outdoor areas, including the poolside, but they cannot enter the pool. Bowls and pet beds are available on advance request. Pets are not allowed in the breakfast room, although alternatives are offered in the lounge bar or room. One pet is allowed in the Açafrão restaurant.

423.description: Vai… Vai Gerês, in the centre of Gerês village, welcomes dogs both indoors and on the terrace. Dogs must be kept on a lead throughout the visit. Being able to choose between indoor and outdoor seating makes it convenient at different times of year. It's a good place to stop for a drink, lunch or dinner before or after exploring the Gerês region with your dog.

424.description: Cantinho Redondo in Froufe, Ponte da Barca, is dog-friendly accommodation that accepts up to two dogs per stay, with no size restrictions or extra pet fee. The house is in Peneda-Gerês National Park, in a peaceful natural setting close to the river and small lagoons. It's a great base for exploring Gerês and enjoying outdoor walks and hikes with your dog.

425.description: Tanoa Café, in Lisbon’s Bairro Alto neighbourhood, welcomes dogs indoors regardless of size. There is no outdoor terrace, but dogs are welcome inside the café. The menu focuses on brunch, with eggs Benedict, pancakes, speciality coffee, matcha and other freshly prepared options. If you're looking for somewhere to stop with your dog in central Lisbon, it's a relaxed and welcoming choice.
